te sa drosde/ wa khro / wa/ snye/sdu/ — byed 7lha nga bye ) ho rdo/ rdo3 9 9 snye ༷ tsho sngo t+t+waṃ ci nga sdo/ /khro rte ༷/tsho/ mas — ‘ 3/ ne / ṭātshoXdro nga ri rtsi/ 7 74 47 mi sna rnyi ༷༷lha ( ( sna rme ༷) kro sgo ( 9 —— /tsho snying ga 07me 94777/70༷༷tā mi ཿ'a lho tshang /chag sna du ri 42di/kau pa gaXl 77 yi sda shā cig ༷ nge dro/lha mochi ru skeX —1 — ༷ sku nga bod ljongasamidamangasadapesanasang/ ——
༄nyu/ / bod kyi ar las skor cung zad brjod pa mthong ba brgyud pa'i lag len/bya rigasapa ṇ+ḍa1bzang rnam rgyal/bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang /

dkar chagadang po/ mkhar grong thog mar skrun skabasakyi sadapyad/ (3)gnyisapa/ lto'aphye'i thig dgosamin/ (5)gsumapa/ khang pa'i bzo bkod kyi khyad par dang khyad chos/(7)bzhi pa/ chu 'khor sogs/ (28)lngapa/ ar ka dang ar gzhas/ (30)drug pa/ ar lasakyi 'phelarim/ (35)bdun pa/ dmigasabasalagyi khyad chosa'aga' shas/ (43)brgyad pa/ rtsig bzo'i skor gyi lan 'debs/ (48)

gzhumamed snying stobasabartanapo'i dmabaca' yis/ /dka' ba'i lasalaji misnyamabazhin du/ /yang yangagasar gtod bgyisanasalegasapa'i 'bras/ /len pa'i bloldan dpa' bo'i tshogasalabasngags/ /mang mang skyebo'i blogrosasnying bcud kyi/ /legasalegasa'abrasabazang gang sar mchisamod kyang / /gsalagasalayigalama'akhod pa misnang bar/ /ngesangesamathong spobargyud pa'i lag len 'di/ /mtho risalhanasa'obaba'i gtam rgyud med/ /gragasacan gcig gisasrolagatod byasangamed/ /rang rigasamesapo'i blodang myong bayi/ /snying pogacigabasdusartsigabazo'i tshula'adi smra/ /

de la 'dir rang re kha ba'i ljongs su ar rgyag 'dzugs skrun gyi lag rtsal la yun ring gi lo rgyus dang dmigs bsal gyi khyad chos yod/dper na lo ngo brgya phrag kha shas kyi gong nas bskrun pa'i pho brang po ta la sogs kyi rtsig pa mi nyung ba zhig da lta skyon med du gnas yod la sa gnas kha shas su gna' dus kyi rtsig pa ma zhig par bsdad pa mang po dngos su mthong rgyu yod pa ma zad/ lag rtsal de dar ba nas bzung rim bzhin deng rabs kyi phyogs su 'phel rgyas 'gro ba de thog nas bod rigs ar rgyag bzo pa'i blo gros dang / dmigs bsal gyi lag rtsal/ khyad 'phags rang bzhin/ zhum med kyi snying stobs bcas mtshon gyi yod/yun ring gi lo rgyus dang mi rigs kyi khyad chos ldan pa'i bod kyi ar rgyag der rgyu cha yul rang nas thon pas mkho chas rgyas bsdus ci rigs byas chog cing / dpe ris dang thig gtong sogs stabs bde ba dang / las jus zhib tshags pas sra zhing brtan pa/ yul gyi don dngos dang mthun pas nyi 'od char rlung sogs phan gnod gang yod dor len 'tshams pa sogs mdor na mi rabs gong ma gong ma nas 'og ma 'og mar brgyud sprod byas pa'i mthong ba brgyud pa'i lag len zhig yin/ 'on kyang bod kyi ar las thad ngal rtsol bya rim dang / rgyu cha'i spus tshad ang grangs/gsar gtod dang legs bcos byed po sogs yig lam du 'khod pa zhig med pa ni ha cang 'phangs po zhig red/ da lam 'dir bod kyi ar las skor cung zad brjod par bya ba las/2

dang po/ mkhar grong thog mar skrun skabs kyi sa dpyad/mkhar grong ngam/ dgon sde/ lha khang sogs thog mar gsar du skrun tshe skrun sa'i yul de dge mtshan bcu tshang ba zhig dgos pa ste/ ji skad du/ khang sa zhing sa sa yi dge/ / 'thung chu zhing chu chu yi dge/ /gam 'brog rgyang 'brog rtswa yi dge/ / khang shing 'bud shing shing gi dge/ / khang rdo thab rdo rdo yi dge/ / zhes pa ltar/ sa chu rtswa shing rdo rnams ni mi'i 'tsho ba'i khrod med du mi rung bas dge mtshan bcu po de dag dang ldan pa'i steng / gnam sa ri klung chu bo sogs bkra shis kyi mtshan ma mtshon pa zhig dgos pa ni sngar gyi dgon gnas dang / lha khang /grong khyim chags yul phal mo cher gnam 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad/ sa pad ma 'dab brgyad/ mtha' skor gyi ri bor bkra shis rtags brgyad dang rgyal srid sna bdun gyi dbyibs sogs ri bshad yod pa ltar/gnam sa ri dpyad legs pa'i thog phyogs bzhir mi 'gyur ba'i gzer chen bzhi ste shar du stag lhor g.yu 'brug nub tu bya/ byang du rus sbal bcas dang / seng ge gnam du mchong ba 'dra ba/ khyung gi 'dab shog brkyangs pa 'dra ba/ g.yu 'brug gyen du langs pa'am tshang du 'khor ba 'dra ba/ stag mo tshang nas don pa 'dra ba/ glang chen no/ bu

khur nas 'ongs pa 'dra ba/ pad ma pha phye ba 'dra ba sogs kyi ri dpyad ni legs shing / de min ri klung du sbrul nag thur la rgyug pa 'dra ba dang /bud med kyi 'doms gzed pa 'dra ba/ sdig pa rwa can gyi dbyibs dang /chu srin de'ur thon 'dra/ glang chen gyi sna la mtshon cha btags te 'ong ba 'dra ba/ ri bo gcig gi rgyab nas gcig bya ra byed pa 'dra ba/ gnam dang sa gru gsum (chos phyogs kyi dgos pa khyad par can phud )sogs ni sa dpyad ngan pa yin/ gong gsal sa dpyad legs pa mang zhing nyes pa nyung ba'i sa der mkhar dang dgon pa sogs khang pa rgyag srol yod/ sa dpyad nyes pa dag gso thabs ni/ sbrul dang sdig pa lta bu'i kha gtad du bya khyung dang / mo mtshan 'dra ba la pho rtags/ chu srin dang / glang chen g.yul du 'chad pa lta bur dung dang seng ge/ ri gcig gi rgyab nas gcig bya ra byed pa lta bur mchod rten nam dar lding sogs kyis bcos na sa dgra ngan pa 'gog pa yin/ khang khyim gsar du skrun pa yin tshe khang rgyab kyi ri ldebs su chu mig mi 'khel ba bya dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni yul grong 'jig par bzhed pa dang / khang rgyab tu shing sdong rkang gcig 'khel ba'am skyes na rgyab phur zhes khyim de'i 'byor pa rgyas par dka' zer bas shing sna mang po 'dzugs pa'am yang na gcig de med par bya dgos/ khang rgyab tu grog shur 'khel ba ni mi nor stong pas ngan zer/mdun gyi ri'i brang khog dang / lto ba stong pa yin na yul de'i mi dpa' snyistu dang longs spyod chung ba'i mtshan mar bshad/ yang mdun ngos su

chu mig 'khel na longs spyod 'phel/ ri bo rin po che spungs pa 'dra bas mnga' thang rgyas pa/ mdun du shing rkang gcig byung na dka' ba las grol ba/ rgyab phyogs su brag ri rdo rje'i dbyibs 'dra yod na tshe ring 'ing dbang thang che ba sogs gsung srol yod/ de ltar sa gzhi gang legs brtags nas mkhar grong ngam lha khang sogs mkhar las kyi bya ba la 'jug par bya'o/ /gnyis pa/ lho 'phye'o thig dgos min/sa stong du gsar skrun byas tshe sa bdag lto 'phye'o thig nges par 'debs dgos pa yin te/ de yang grub mtha' so so'i bzhed pa bzhin phyag len la mkhas pa'i bla ma dge 'dun gdan drangs te khong rnams pas rgyud dang grub chen gyi man ngag bzhin sa brtag pa dang / bslangs pa/sbyang ba sogs bya dgos pas de dag gi tshul so so'i lugs mang du yod pas 'dir 'bri bar mi langs pas zhib par mkhyen 'dod na phyag len la mkhas pa dag las mkhyen par mdzod/ 'on kyang lto 'phye'i sa slong dgos dang mi dgos tshul cung zad tsam zhig dbyangs can grub pa'i rdo rje'i gsung ltar drangs na 'di ltar/ de yang 〈gsang ba spyi rgyud 〉las/drang srong gnas dang ba lang lhad/ / phug dang ri yi rtse mo dang / / sa gzhi gang na 'bas pa dang / / khang stong dang ni rdo leb dang /5 /

mchod rten drung dang 'bab chu'i gling / / mtsho rnams kyi ni 'gram dag tu/ / sa gzhi sbyang dang brtag pa dang / / nan tan du ni bya mi dgos/ / tha bar bcag kyang der mi dgos/ / mtho dman la sogs skyon rnams kyang / / der ni dogs pa skye mi dgos/ / zhes dang /sngon du byas pa'i gnas dag tu/ / ma brkos na yang dag pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gnas de dag tu rdzas sngags ting nge 'dzin dang bla med kyis sbyang pa tsam las sa brkos nas sbyang ba dang brtag pa'i skor rnams mi dgos la de las gzhan pa'i gnas rnams la ni 〈rdo rje mkha' 'gro 〉las/ gtsug lag khang dang khang bzang dang / / mchod rten dkyil 'khor grong khyer dang / / khyim dang sdum ra la sogs la/ / lto 'phye'o lto bar rko ba dang / / zhes gsungs pas lto 'phye'o brtag pa sogs kyang nges par dgos so/ / zhes gsungs/ lto 'phye'i brtag pa bya tshul cho ga dbyangs can grub pa'i rdo rjes gsungs pa'i 〈sa brtags pa bslangs pa sbyang ba gsum gyi lag len gsal bar bshad pa legs tshogs sgo brgya 'byed pa'i lde mig 〉ces par gsal/gzhan yang / mkhar las brtsig bzor tshes cha gza' skar sogs sil legs nyes kyi dbye ba 〈'bras rtsis be+e dkar dgongs don 'dri med kun phan me long 〉zhes pa la sogs par gsal ba ltar gza' dang /tshes cha/ skar ma sogs gang legs rtsis 'bras ltar las 'go 'dzugs kyi yod/6

gsum pa/ khang pa'i bzo bkod kyi khyad par dang khyad chos/bod kyi khang pa'i bzo bkod la spyir na rigs gsum du dbye chog pa ste dgon pa dang pho brang / mang tshogs kyi sdod khang bcas yin/ de yang lha khang ni dgon pa dang mtshungs la/ rdzong khang dang sger khag gi gzhis khang ni pho brang gi khongs su gtogs shing / mang tshogs kyi khang par yang grong khyer dang grong gseb la 'tsho ba'i gnas stangs kyi rkyen pas khyad par yod pa bcas red/1 dgon pa'i bzo bkod ni 'og khang gi dbus su 'du khang dang / sbug tu gtsang khang / mdor sgo mchor/ 'du khang la ka ring (gnyis nas mi nyung ba )dang / ka thung / 'du khang gi sgo steng seng ge dang bab khebs sogs kyi mdzes rgyan/ sgo mchor la ka spungs/ mdun du rdo skas/ sgo mchor steng gi dbus kyi khang par rab gsal dang /g.yas g.yon du sge khung chung ba/ ka ring la seng g.yab dang de'i mdun ngos rnam thar sgo gsum sogs dkar gsal/ mtha' 'khor du khang mig che chung sna tshogs/ yang steng du rgya phebs sam/ gañdzir/ rtsig zur khag tu rten thug rab gsal gyi thog steng g.yas g.yon du gser zangs sam ras kyi rgyal mtshan dang / dbus su gser zangs kyi chos kyi 'khor lo dang / ri dwags pho mo/ rtsig pa'i steng khor yug tu spen bad/ blo'i

ldebs gser zangs kyi rtags brgyad dang / rnam bcu dbang ldan sogs kyi ri mos brgyan pa/ spen bad steng nya rgyab 'og bad phur kha shing la skar ma'i phreng ba/ dbu rtser rgya phebs dang mda' g.yab yod na spen bad kyi zur du gser zangs kyi seng ge/ rtsig zur khag gi gong la'i 'og dril bu sogs mdzes rgyan dang/ sgo mchor gyi g.yas g.yon dang rab gsal mdun du stag khra gtong srol yang yod/ dgon pa'i 'du khang gi g.yas g.yon gang rung zhig tu rung khang dang / 'du khang che gras rnams su ja sgo zhes rung khang dang thad dkar 'brel ba'i sgo zhig bzo srol bcas yod/lha khang mang che ba ni dgon pa'i dbyibs dang 'dra ba bcas so/ /2 pho brang gi bzo dbyibs ni 'og shod du mdzod khang dang /bar thog tu gnyer tshang dang / phyag mdzod khang sogs las khungs tshugs yul/ las byed kyi sdod shag thab tshang sogs dang / steng khang du gtso bo'i zhugs gnas gzim chung sogs bzo srol yod/ 'og khang phal cher la brag shur dang phyir rlung 'gro chung ngu re dang / bar thog dang steng khang rnams la sge khung rim pa ltar che ba dang / khang pa'i mdun gyi dbus su rab gsal/ rtse thog la khra shel/ khang pa'i dbus dkyil du tshoms chen ska ring dang seng g.yab can/ tshoms chen ni sku gsung thugs rten bzhugs gnas dang mdzad sgo che rigs bya yul red/ tshoms chen gyi ka gdung la shing sangs brtsegs ma rim pa bcu gsum dang ldebs bristu sogs la mdzes rgyan rgyas spros byed srol dang / rtse thog la gzim

chung nyi 'od ces rgyun gtan gyi mdzad sgo chung gras gnang yul byed la rgyun gtan rje bo bzhugs sa yang yin/ mtshan mo gzim khang dang /zhal 'don khang / phyag dpe khang sogs yod pa de rnams kyi ka gdung dang / sgo/ sge khung / khra ru sogs la gzugs dbyibs 'dra min gyi shing brkos dang / ldebs ris bcas mdzes rgyan spros pa dang / zhabs phyi khang dang / 'gro lam/ bar 'khyam sogs la 'jam zhal tshon rtsi spyir btang zhig gtong srol dang / 'og khang gi rigs la rtsig ldebs su rtsub zhal las mi gtong / sgo mchor la ka spungs dang / rgyal sgor glang sna/bre 'gyogs/ yang steng du rgya phebs dang / gañdzir/ thug rgyal mtshan sogs dgon pa dang mtshungs la thog steng rtsig zur so sor dar lcog kyang 'dzugs kyi yod/2 rdzong khang dang / gzhis khang khag kyang pho brang dang 'dra rung yang steng du ras tshos sna can gyi rgyan mtshan dang / thug dar lcog rnams 'dzugs kyi yod pa las gzhan gyi rgyas spros rnams med pa'i khyad par yod/ sngar gyi pho brang ngam/ rdzong khang / gzhis khang sogs kyi khang pa che gas la sgo mchor bzo srol 'dug kyang phyis su bzo dbyibs rim 'gyur gyis sgo mchor bzo srol med/( pho brang ngam gzhis khag gi khang par spro khang zhes spro skyid byed yul gling kha'i nang thog brtsegs gnyis sam thog gcig sdings cha can khra shel mang po yod pa bskrun gyi yod/ de dag ni ma khang gi nye 'gram du kha khu sim la bzo bkod dang tshon rtsi'i mdzeḥ cha

dang ldan pa bzo srol yod/)4 mang tshogs kyi sdod khang la yang grong khyer dang grong gseb dbar bzo bkod la khyad par yod/ grong khyer la'ang sger khang dang spyi khang gnyis kyi khyad par yod kyang spyir btang rang bdag khang pa rgya lam 'gram gsar du brgyab pa rnams 'og la tshong khang dang de'i rgyab kyi dkar khung 'don yul med pa dang bsil po yod sar dos khang / steng du nyi dros phog yul la bab bstun gyis gzim chung dang thab tshang / 'og tu tshong khang 'don yul med sar khang gla gtong byed dkar cha gang thon bcas skrun gyi yod/ spyi sger gyis khang glar gtong ba'i mang tshogs them grangs mang po 'du sdod kyi khang pa phal cher 'og khang (rgya lam gram tshong khang 'don pa phud )dkar gsal cung chung ba dang / bar thog dang steng khang dkar cha dod la steng khang du bkod pa gang mdzes/ shing char bzo rtsal yang phran bu legs pa bzo srol yod pa bcas yin/ grong gseb tu ma khang thog brtsegs sam thog gcig gi nye 'khor du gzan khang dang / phyugs rigs 'jug khang sogs bzo ba bcas byed/ khang pa yongs rdzogs kyi yang steng (rong mtshams phud )thog leb yin pas mi rnams nyi ma bsro ba dang / bza' bca'i rigs skam pa sogs byas chogakhams khul gyi thog steng du 'bru rigs ston bsdus tshar ma bzhag ste brngo 'thag byed ran so sor g.yul las kyis bza' com pos par spyad chog pardo hāgo mtshan yod stabs g.yul thang zur du ma dgos par thog kur

byed pa der thog rdung zhes bshad srol yang yod/ kong po sogs rong mtshams dang / sa yom gyi nyen kha che sar sa bab mi 'dra stabs khang pa rgyag stangs kyang cung mi 'dra ba yod pa ste khang pa'i rtsig 'gram phyogs so sor ka ba re btsugs te thog brtsegs ma long tsam dang de nas shing sbom phra dang ring thung gzhi mtshungs yin pa zhe gcig gi sner bcad kha bsgrigs te rtsig gi yod pa de ni sa yom shugs che'i skabs rtsig pa 'gyel kyang thog mi rdib pa dang / mi dang dngos po srung skyob kyi nyen srung nus pa chen po yod/ rtsig pa'i 'gram gyi ka thog tu gdung ma 'gel ba dang/ pang leb mthug po'i pang gcal 'ding ba/ nyis thog yin na steng du ka ba yod med sna tshogs thog rtsig zur du ka ba dang gdung ma gong bzhin la khang pa che chung la dpag nas rab gsal dang / sge khung 'don pa/ thog kha rgya khang gzugs ni rgyab mdun gyi ka ba thung ba dang / dkyil du ring tsam/gdung ma zur gsum bkal ba'i thog pang leb bya spu gnon gyis bsgrigs shing de'i steng rlung gnon rdo g.yam gyis mnan pa/ khyim tshang che gras kyi steng khang la dkyil du ka ring btsugs te seng g.yab bzo ba yang yod/khams khul du rtsig pa phal cher gyang dang mnga' ris dang byang phyogs rtswa thangakhul du rtsig pa la ma yin pa thog gcig ma sha stag dang de'i rtsig pa brtan po yong ba byed phyir shing phur rgyag gi yod/ dgon pa dang / pho brang phud mang tshogs sdod gnas kyi khang pa tshang ma'i yang steng gi rtsig zur du lha tshugs re bzo srol yang yod pa red/ 11

bod kyi khang pa rgyag stangs kyi khyad chos gzhan zhig ni khang pa phal cherakha lho lta bzo srol yod pa de yin la de yang dgun dus nyi 'od khang pa'i nang 'phros te dro zhing dkar cha dod pa'i khyad yin/ grong khyer nang du spyi sger gyi khang pa khang gla gtong yul dang gzhung lam gyi 'gram du ma gtogs gzhung sgo 'don yul med pa rnams phud/ de min gzhung sgo dang / skas 'dzegs byang phyogs su kha gtad pa dang / sgo dang skas 'dzegs thad gar 'khel na ngan par brtsi zhing / gal srid de star 'khel na rgyal sgo'i gdong du rtsig bcad cig rgyag gi yod/ phyi sgo'am rgyal sgor ru 'gram du pad 'dab dang steng du byi'u sogs mdzes rtsal gang che 'don srol dang / gzhung sgo 'don yul gyi phyogs su chu mig dang /ri dpyad gang legs 'khel thabs byed la khang rgyab tu chu mig dang shing sdong rkang gcig sogs 'khel na ngan par brtsi/ nye 'khor du sa dgra ngan pa ste/ dper na ri sdig pa rwa can dang mo mtshan ltar yod na rtsig pa'i mtho sar bya khyung dang / shing ngam rdo las pho mtshan sogs kyi bzo bzos nas bzlog thabs su sbyar gyi yod/ gzhan yang gong la'i phyi ngos la shar du stag lhor 'brug nub bya/ byang du rus sbal bcas kyi gzugs brnyan rdo la bskos nas bkra mi shes pa rnams bzlog pa'i mtshon byed du sbyor ba yin/ khang pa phal cher gyi shod mdzod lte ba dang / steng gi tshoms chen lta bu'i khang mig gtso che rnams byang ngos dang / thab tshang shasda spra/ gsang gcod lho nub mtshams su bzo srol yod pa ni/ 〈khang

bshad 〉du'ang byang phyogs gnod sbyin phyogs su mdzod bya/ shar lho me lha'i mtshams su bab bca'/ lho nub dri za'i mtshams su gcod bca' zhes rgyun srol gyi lam ltar yongs khyab tu dar bzhin yin 'dug de bzhin bod kyi khang pa'i bzo dbyibs ja khra gzugs zhes mdun nas rgyab bar thog brtsegs rim spar gyis bzo ba dang/ rtsig zur mang po dang /zur brgyad/ rgyab tu glo 'bur 'don pa/ phyi dbyibs phal cher gru nar stabs su bskrun srol yod pa de yang sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i〈be+eḍūr+ya dkar po 〉las khang pa gru bzhir 'khrug pa rgyun mi 'chad/ ces mi shes par gsungs pa ltar ltas ngan bzlog 'gyur gyi ched du yin par snang/spyir btang dgon pa sogs kyi gong lar spen bad gtong ba dang de min rnam la spen rdzus sam spang rgya (la ma brtsigs nas tshos nag byugs pa )yang na gong la'i gong 'og gnyis su bad bur kha shing re gtong srol yod pa bcas yin/ gtsug lag khang bzhengs stangs ni/ gtsug lag khang zhes pa sde snod dam gsung rab bzhugs sa'i gnas sam/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten bzhugs sa'am dkon mchog gi pho brang zhes bya ba yin/ 〈'dul ba'i dpe ris 〉su skye bo mang po'i bsod nams gsog pa'i slad du bzhengs pa'i gtsug lag khang ngos gcig gi dbus su dri gtsang khang dang / ngos gzhan gsum du gnas khang gsum re yod pa'i khyams bzhi pa can gru bzhi pa'i dpe ste/ lag gi blas 'ong ba dang 'gro ba dang ldan pa'i sdusar

gtsug lag khang bya'o/ / ngos gcig gi dbus su dri gtsang khang bya ba nyid do/ / de'i mdun du sgo khang ngo / / gru bzhi bzang ba nyid do/ /zhes pa ltar/ dbus sam phyogs gcig tu sku gsung thugs kyi rten bzhugs pa'i lha khang de'i mdun du dge 'dun 'du khang / mtha' skor du grwa shag ste gnas khang / 'du khang gi sgo mdun sgo mchor sogs dang /thog tshad nges med steng du rgya phebs mda' g.yab sogs kyis brgyan pa yod/ skrun sa'i yul ni ston pa sangs rgyas sogs dam pa gong mas lung bstan cing byin gyis brlabs pa'i sa dang gnas yul sa bcad dge mtshan ldan pa zhig tu skrun gyi yod/dgon pa ni grong las rgyang grags gcig tshad pa'i dben pa'i gnas sam dge mdun mang po 'du gnas shig yin/ ming gi rnam grangs su klog grwa'i gnas dang/ mkhas gnas/ chos kyi grong rdal/chos kyi 'dun sa sogs brjod/ de la bshad grwa dang / sgrub grwa/ pho dgon/ mo dgon/ grwa sa/ gzhis dgon sogs grwa btsun dang /bshad sgrub/ slob gnyer bya yul dang slob gnyer byed mkhan gyi yong khungs sogs kyi gzhi khyon dang / nyams len gyi cha nas ming btags pa las 'dzugs skrun khang bzo gzhi khyon che chung dang / bshad grwa khag la chos ra dang dam bca'i khri/ sgrub grwar mtshams khang khag gi khyad par de ma gtogs 'du khang dang / grwa shag sogs ni phal cher 'dra/ 'on kyang da// pa'i nang gi grwa shag la spyi sger gyi khang pa'i bzo khyad yod pa ni/

spyi khang phal cher thog brtsegs mtho la ra sgor gcig gi nang shag 'khor 'khor mo yug tu yod pa'i nang sdod shag khang mig che chung sna tshogs mang po yod/ sger shag la gzim chung dang / thab tshang / gnyer tshang sogs khang mig mang la re 'gar sgo ra'i nang rta ra yang yod pa sogs yin/mkhar rdzong ni/ spyir na mkhar zhes pa ni sa rdo'i rtsig pa mtho zhing gzhi khyon che tsam yod pa'am/ dbang 'dzin dpon rigs kyi bzhugs gnas sam lcags ris skor ba'i gzhi khyon che tsam yod pa'i grong la'ang 'jug pa sogs yin/ rdzong zhes pa ni ri sna dang sa cha btsan 'gag tu chags pa la zer/ dper na mkhar gyi dang po yum bu bla sgang zhes pa lta bu dang / pho brang po ta la thog mar skrun pa'i skabs kyi lo rgyus nang mkhar dgu brgya dang dgu bcu go dgu/ rtse mor rgyal po'i sku mkhar dang bcas zhes gsal/ gzhan yang rgyal po'i sku mkhar/ lta'i rten mkhar lta bu dang / rdzong la brag rdzong / btsan rdzong / dgra rdzong sogs kyis mtshon 'gog srung gi nus pa ldan pa'i sa cha dang / mkhar rtser so khung yod pa'i khang par zer/ dper na phag gru'i dus su rdzong chen bco brgyad rtsig yul phal cher sa 'gag btsan po'i ri snar yod la de tsho phal che bar lcags ri mtho po'i ngos su so khung dang rdzog rdo 'phang sa dang sa 'og gi dong lam brgyud ri gsham du chu len par 'gro sa sogs yod/phyis su rdzong zhes srid 'dzin sa khul de dang der dbang bsgyur stabs mkhar rdzong gi ming sa char thogs/15

las ma'i brgyud rim ni/ spyir na khang pa che chung gang zhig brgyab rung rdo bzo dang / shing bzo/ zhal dpon/ lcags bzo/ zangs bzo/tshon pa sogs dgos pa ma zad/ dgon pa'am pho brang lta bu'i 'dzugs skrun gzhi rgya che rigs la gong gi bzo rigs thog lha bris pa dang /'jim bzo ba/ 'tshem bzo ba sogs bzo rigs 'dra min dgos pa de dag so sos rkang 'dzin gyi nus pa 'don pa dang / lhag par rdo bzo ba dang / shing bzo ba dbu chen dang / dbu chung / dkyus ma/ zhal dpon/ lag g.yog sogs yod/ rdo shing gi dbu chen gnyis ni gtso bo yin pa ste/ shing bzo dbu chen gyis khang pa'i sa bkra 'bri ba dang / rdo bzo dbu chen dang mnyam 'brel gyis las kur jus bkod 'don gyi yod/dbu chung gis dbu chen la rogs ram dang 'brel las yul rang du las kur dngos su zhugs pa/ dkyus ma tshos dbu che chung gi thig tshad ngag bkod bzhin shing dras gzhog sgrig bzo 'don dang / dge phrug rnams nas gtso bor rgyag ste'ur brten nas shing che rigs gzhog pa/ khang pa'i mtho dma' sogs kyi tshad 'dzin rgyug 'dom zhes rgyug tshad zhig yod pa de shing bzo dbu chen gyis bdag 'dzin byed pa dang / rdo bzo dbu chen gyis rtsig bzo'i bkod 'doms bya rgyu dang / rtsig pa'i kha zheng thig skud dam rgyug tshad kyis tshad len/ rtsig zur bcag gdong sogs gal che'i rtsig par lta zhib/ dbu chung gis rtsig zur 'gan len dang gzhung skya/ ཿlta ba dang / rdo bzo byings kyis rtsig par blta rtogs bkod sgrig

rdo bzo byings nas gzhung skya'i rtsig pa brtsig rgyu dang rtsig rdor bzo 'don pa/ dge phrug tshos cab le bzo rgyu dang rtsig pa'i nang rtsis rgyag dgos/lag g.yog nas bsing rdo rgyag pa dang mig 'dag rgyong ba/ rdo chen dang sel hrug cab le/ 'dag chen/ sa 'bol sogs dbor skyel byed/zhal dpon gyis ldebs zhal 'jam rtsub/ mthil zhal/ thog steng dang nya rgyab sogs kyi ar ka bcog pa/ mdzub ris rgyag rgyu/ nag rtsi rgyag pa sogs kyi 'gan 'khur byed/ bod khang gi rgyu char rdo/ shing/ sa gsum la yang rigs mi 'dra ba mang po dgos pa ste rdo la rdo chen dang / rdo byugardo g.yam/ g.yam pa/ chu rdo sogs dang / sa ni sa dmar dang sa dkar/ sa dkyus ma/ bye ma/ sib pa bye ma (chu nang gi bye ma ) sogs dang gzhan yang ba sag dang / ar ka/ shing la yang mkhregs shing dang gsom shing / stag pang / pang leb sogs sbom phra che chung sna tshogs dgos pa bcas red/khang pa gsar rgyag byed skabs thog mar khang pa rgyag yul du rtsis pas (sngags pa ) sa bdag lto 'phye'i thig 'debs pa sogs rtsis gzhung dang chos lugs nas bshad pa'i cho ga dang bcos thabs rnams sngon du song rjes sa shur thog mar 'dru mkhan ming bkra legs pa pha ma nyis 'dzoms shig gis 'jor sbyag khar gser dngul gyis byugs pa/ yu bar kha btags dkris pa zhig khyer nas phyogs gtsang la bltas te sa brkos zin pa dang las mi rnams nas rtsig rmang drus/ de'ang khang pardo zlog

brtsegs la gzhigs te (gting ring thung yod )drus steng seng rdo brgyab ste bcag bcag gtong dgos pa de ni rmang gzhi brtan po yong min rag lusas yin pas gal shin tu che/(dmangs khrod shod srol du rtsig pa'i yon tan 'og la yod zer ) de nas rtsig rmang nang rdo'am chur rdo gding dgos/ phyi nang gnyis ga'i rdo chen brtsigs rjes khog rdo rgyong ba dang rdo chen gyi ngor thig btang ste 'dag chen brgyab/ de'i thog 'dag rdo sil hrug sa sbol/ cab le/ cab rgyong / srubs bkag seng rdo rgyag pa sogs go rim ltar thog brtsegs yongs su ma longs bar byed dgos/rtsig pa'i phyi ngos kyi rdo la bzo 'don pa las nang rdor bzo 'don ha lam mi dgos/ rtsig rdo gnyis bar du bcug pa'i rdo la cab le zer ba ni rdo chen gnyis kyi sne mnan pa dang mi 'gyur ba'i ched dang / phyi nang gi rtsig rdo nyis gshib dbar gyi stong char khog rdo zhes pas stong cha rgyong ba/ khog 'dag zhes sa spus dag gi 'dam pa blugs nas 'dag rdo dang seb hrug ces rdo gshags tshal rgyong srol yod/ rdo chen re khrid nas sa sbol brgyab ste cab le khrid pa'i nang du cab rgyong zhes rdo drug rgyong / cab le khrid pa dang rdo bstar re rer seng rdo brgyab pa des rdo chen gyi rkyong 'bur rnams snyoms thub pa'i dgos pa'ang yod la sa yom gyi gnod pa dang gtso bor babs nod la 'gan len yang yod/ bod khang rnying pa tshang mar rtsig rdo snyal ba dang rdo mjug ring ba/ sgrog ma shor ba rtsig pa'i khog pa stong char ma stasbya pa/ rdo the'u yis bcag bcag gzab nan gtong ba bcas byas

par brten brtan po dang rdo phan tshun sgrog rgyag bde ba dang rtsig par ser ka mi gas pa sogs kyi khyad chos chen po ldan yod/rtsig pa'i mtho tshad ni shing bzo dbu chen gyis rgyug 'dom la tshad zin thog rtsig pa'i zur gyi 'then dang ngos kyi thad 'drong los sogs ni rdo bzo dbu chen gyi bkod pa bzhin dbu chung nas 'phyong 'bebs dang thig gtong ba sogs byed kyi yod/ 'then gtong ba'i dgos pa ni thog brtsegs rim par bkab 'og gi rtsig rdor gnon shugs chung du gtong ba'i ched dang / lhag par ri'i sgang du khang pa thog brtsegs can rgyag dgos tshe rtsig par 'then ma btang na 'grig thabs med pa zhig rang red 'dug de ltar thog tshad re long mtshams shing bzo dbu chung gis 'gan blangs nas gra sgrig zin pa'i ka gdung dang sgo sge khung gi shing sangs rnams la bcad kha yang rtags bkod pa ltar bsgrigs/ ka ba slong skabs g.yas g.yon nas shing skyor bsdams/ ka steng du 'be log ('be log shing star kha byung na rab dang / de min 'be log dang ka ba'i bar mkhregs shing srab bu zhig 'jug dgos )de'i steng gzhu ring/ de'i steng gdung ma/ de'i steng 'og khang lta bur lcam gtong ba dang / steng khang la gdung ma'i steng pad ma chos brtsegs sogs rim par brtsegs rjes lcam gtong ba dang / dral ma/ dral rdo/ thog 'dag rnams rim par gtong dgos pa rnams zin rjes sgo dang sge khung gi ru bzhi rnams sgrig sbyor byed kyi yod/ thog khang dang lha khang lta bur dral ma'i rgyu ni shing gi ya/ sna'i

pags pa bshus nas ngos gcig zlum dbyibs thung bzos bstar sgrig byas pa de dag la steng sgrig zer/ khang pa re 'gar dral ma pang srab dang dral ma'i mgo mjug la phur bzo'i rtse bton te sgrig srol yod/('di la dral ma phur gzugs zer )'og khang lta bur dral ma shing gi yal ga phra po'am shing gshags dral ma gtong gi yod/ de'i thog chu rdos mnan par dral rdo zer/ thog 'dag ni sa dmar ram dur rtsi yod pa'i sa yis rgyag srol dang / de'i steng ar ka gcog dgos/ dral mar shing ring po btang na ar ka gcog dus sbir brgyab nas ar gal mi 'grigs pa'i skyon cha yod/ (ar ka gcog lugs dang phan nus/ bdag gces byed lugs skor zur du bris yod ) gong la spyi khre gang tsam brtsigs thog de'i khar bad phur kha shing dang chu len rdo g.yam (bad g.yam )btang steng sa rdo'i 'bur bzos steng ar ka bcag par gong chu'am pu shud (nya rgyab )zer/ ar ko dang sba sag gang rung bcag srol/ thog kha'i chu 'gro 'or pa ni shing la shur drus pa spyi khre phyed do tsam dgos/ de sngon dgon sde dang lha khang la 'or pa zangs kyi mdong mo bzo srol yod/ (bar lam zangs dang lcags shog gis bzos pa )gong la'i 'og nas bug pa bzos pa'i nang nas phyir gtong ba/ khang pa'i thog 'dag rgyag skabs chu 'gro bde khyad mtho dma' thog 'dag thig nas bzo srol yod/ gong lar spen bad 'khrid stangs ni brtsig pa'i mtho tshad tshad gzhi lon pa'i ma/sdus su bad bur dang kha shing la sgor mo'i shing brkos dang de'i steng

bad g.yam/ de nas rdo ar kong gi cab le sgal gra snyom po bsgrigs pa'i steng spen ma skam po pags pa bshus te sbom phra lag ngar tsam gyi chun bu ring thung snyom sgrig byas nas rgyun bus bsdams pa brtsigs nas shing tsher pa'i phur pa spen ma'i dkyil brgyab ste 'khod snyom pa'i steng du bad bur kha shing thog tu shing thog tu shing sgor mo brkos ldan gral sgrig dang bad g.yam nya rgyab sogs spyi mtshungs dang / spen bad kyi nang ngos su rdo brtsig dgos/ spen brtsegs la btsag byug pa/ ldebs thod du skar ma zhes shing sgor mor sa dkar byug pa bstar sgrig dang ldebs su gser zangs kyi spen rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ spen bad che chung nyis brtsegs kyang rgyagasrol yod/ yang khang pa re zung la spen rdzus zhes spen ma'i tshab rdo brtsigs la btsag byug pa'ang yod pa red/ phyi rtsig rnams zin rjes bar bcad sa phag gis rtsig stangs ni sa phag phred dang gzhung gang bder blangs nas ka ba'i bar brtsig dgos/ yang na bcad kur btsugs te bcad rgyag pa/ bar bcad la pang bcad dang / shag ma yang gtong srol yod/spyir na rtsig par rdo dang/ gyang / sa phag sogs kyis rtsig gi yod pa las gong du brjod pa ni rdo rtsig skor yin/ sa phag gi rtsig par 'og tu chu len rdo bstar kha shas khrid steng sa phag lnga nas gsum bar phred gzhung spel mar brtsigs shing / gna' rabs su sa phag (sa phag gi ring tshad kung h+phin dgu bcu tsam dang zheng la kung h+phin lnga bgā rlom

snang )drug skor zhes phag gsum 'go sbrel gyis phred du bkal nas brtsigs pa yang 'dug rtsig pa yongs su grub rjes zhal dpon gyi bkod sgrig ltar zhal ba gtong dgos shing / 'og khang lta bur sa dkyus mar bye ma bsres (sa gsum gcig la bye ma gsum gnyis )shing gi 'ded pang gyis zhal ba gtong ba der rtsub zhal zer/ lha khang dang / steng khang sogs khang pa rgyan spros bya yul rnams la zhal gdan zhes rtsub zhal gyi 'khod snyoms po'i steng ba dkar bzhi cha gcig la srid pa bye zhib thal ba ma 'dres pa bzhi cha gsum bsres nas g.yos sbyor gyi byug thog dbur rdos 'jam snyoms bzos pa der zhal chen zhes zer/ khang pa'i nang gi zhal bar 'jam zhal dang rtsub zhal zhes go rim gnyis dang / phyi rtsig rdo rtsig la zhal ba gtong srol med/ gyang dang sa phag gi rtsig par zhal ba gtong stangs rigs 'ga' shas yod kyang phal cher mdzub ris rgyag srol dang sa rgyu cung spus dag tsam dgos/ mthil zhal ni 'og khang la rdo gcal lam sa dmar gyi zhal ba bting ba dang / stong khang rnams su cha rkyen dang bstun nas pang gcal 'ding ba dang / zlor lnga gcog kyi yod/ pang gcal yang dang dod che bas shug pa dkar dmar sgrig pa dang / stag pang sgrig srol yod/ ar kur yang dkar dmar gnyis las ar dmar legs shing lha khang sogs la ar ka gcog skabs g.yu byur sogs kyi rgyan spros byed pa yang yod/ sgo dang sge khung gi g.yas g.yon/ 'og shag 'a/dri sogs la nag rtsi gtong stangs ni rtsub zhal btang zin nas skam

rjes ba dkar dang bye ma bsres pa'i zhal ba rlon par rdo nag (rdo sol )zhib mor brdungs pa ras 'thum gyis brdabs te dbur rdo zhes chu rdo 'jam pos dbur rgyag dgos/de ltar phyi nang gi rtsig pa zhal ba dang bcas pa legs par zin rjes tshon gtong gi yod pa red/ 'og khang mi sdod phan med pa'i rigs la phal cher shing tshon yang gtong srol med kyang sge khung dang sgo steng sogs rgyas spros la gzhigs pas tshon gtong ba dang sgo chen la cung rgyan spros ldan pa'i ri mo bris kyi yod/ dgon pa dang / lha khang / pho brang sogs la sgo mchor du shing brtsegs so so'i rkos rig dang mthun pa'i tshon mdangs spel ma gser shog gis rgyan spros/ rgyal sgo'i g.yas g.yon du rgyal chen sde bzhi dang / srid pa 'khor lo/ 'jig rten chags tshul/'dul ba'i dpe ris sogs dang/ 'du khang ngam pho brang gi tshoms chen sogs la seng g.yab kyi gyang ngos dang / rtsig ldebs su rku brnyan dang /gtam rgyud/ rnam thar sogs 'bri srol yod/ ka gdung la rgyan ris sna tshogs yod pa de ltar ldebs bris dang shing tshon tshang mar gser chus rgyan ris sam bris skur zhal gser phul ba ma zad/ la lar gzhi dmar por gser chus ri mo 'bri ba dang / gzhi grang gser la mtshal gyi ri mo bris pa yang yod/ khang pa phal che ba'i gdung mar tshon rigs sna tshogs dang /lcam la sngon po/ dral ma ljang ser/ yang na gdung lcam dmar ser dang/dral ma skyer kha/ thog mtshams su gzhi dkar ser la me tog sa /ga

gsham bu'i ris/ rtsig gzhi'i tshos mdog dmar ser/ de gsham dmar ljang sngo gsum gyi sked ris/ gsham char rgya smug bcas la sked ris mthang sham zer/ khyim pa'i khang par chos khang lta bur gong gsal ltar dang / de min gos chen gyi ri mo'am dus bzhi'i me tog yang na tshos gzhi sna gcig sogs gtong srol yod/ khang pa phal cher gyi 'og thog tu rdo skas dang steng thog rnams su shing skas bzo rgyun yod/ gna' dus su dochen gyi 'og tu rdo chen gru bzhi (mi gcig gi pang du len thub tsam brtsigs nas bzo ba'ang yod )dper na/ rtse po ta la'i phebs lam dang pho brang dmar po'i sgo mchor mdun gyi rdo skas lta bu yin zhing / dus rabs nyi shu pa'i lo rabs nyi shu'i snga rjes nas rgya rdo dkrug pa'i lag rtsal 'phel rgyas chen po byung ste rgya rdo'i rdo skas dar khyab chen po byung ba ni/dper na/ po ta la'i shar brgyud (pho brang dkar po )tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i sku dus su nyams gso byas pa'i rdo skas dang / se 'bras kyi 'du khang sgo mchor/ mdun gyi rdo skas sogs nas mngon/shing skas legs gras su sgrom skas zhes g.yas g.yon du pang leb mthug po'i sgrom skyor dang skas gdang mnyam sbyar gyis thad gar bzo ba dang /lo rabs nyi shu pa'i yas mas nas skas 'dzegs phyed skyog gam/ yang na skas khung ston yul nang skas 'dzegs sgor 'khyud du 'gro yul bzos pa'ang khang pa'i nang gi sa cha mang po chud zos mi 'gro ba'i khyad/ khams khuX ṭī 'dre skas zhes gdung ril sbom po gcig la nyag ga rim gtod

kyis 'dzegs mas bzo ba deng skabs kyang bzo bed byed/ khul de tsho'i mi rnams ni/ goms nas bsla bar mi 'gyur ba'i/ / dngos de gang yangayod ma yin/ / zhes pa ltar 'dre skas der rdog khres chen po khur nas babs 'dzegs byed cing / goms pa med pa zhig yin na 'khur po khyer rgyu lta zhig stong 'dzegs kyang dka' ba 'dug da dung skas kyi gdang bu rgyug ril gyis kyang bzo srol yang yod/ khang pa'i phyi ngos su dgon pa'am pho brang lta bu 'ga' zhig la btsag dang sa ser gtong ba phud/ de min khang pa phal cher la sa dkar gtong ba dang / sa skya'i chos lugs 'dzin mkhan gyi dgon pa dang lha khang sogs la sa dkar dang btsag sa nag bcas spel mar gtong srol 'dug bad bur kha shing la btsag kho na las gzhan pa gtong srol med pa bcas yin/ de ltar gong du brjod pa ltar rang re'i mes po tshos yun ring gi nyams myong dang / mi rigs gzhan gyi lag rtsal nas kha gsab byas pa bcas la brten nas cung cha tshang tsam yin pa'i mi rigs kyi khyad chos ldan pa'i bzo skrun 'di bzhin byed po gcig gis gsar gtod byas pa dang yang na mi las 'das pa zhig gi nus mthur brten nas gsar shes byung ba zhig ma yin la rnying pa kho nar zhen nas bsdad pa zhig kyang ma yin par/ ru las skyes dang lha bu mgo dkar lta bu'i blo ldan nyams zhib pa du ma'i blo gros kyi snying bcud cig dang / bod mi rigs kyi lag rtsal rin chen bang mdzod nang gi nor bukhyad du 'phags pa zhig red/ de thog nas bod kyi lag rtsal ༵༵ pa

rnams ni rnying pa mtha' dag lha yis byas pa dang / gsar pa mtha' dag bdud kyi sprul par bsam mkhan zhig min pa'i ra sprod byung ba mtshon pa red/ des na rang res mi rabs gong ma'i byas rjes la dran gso dang sbrags gna' bzang deng spyod kyi rmang gzhi'i thog deng rabs kyi phyogs su 'phel rgyas gtong ba'i blo nus kyang nges par skyes dgos/gong gsal dgon pa lha khang (ri khrod dang sgrub grwa tshud )dang / pho brang / mkhar rdzong / mi drag gi khang pa/ grong khyer dang / grong gseb kyi khang bzo sogs brjod zin pa phud/ da dung ma ṇi lha khang dang /maṇa thang /(tsha khang ) mchod rten sna tshogs/ yul lha'i rten mkhar/bsang khung sogs gzhi khyon che chung gang 'dra zhig yin rung rtsig pa'i 'gro phyogs (mchos rten phud )ha lam gcig mtshungs yin/ 'on kyang ma ṇi chu skor ni rtsig pa'i 'og nas chu gzar shugs che tsam yod pa'i yur bu'i nang ma ṇi 'khor chen gyi rting pa btsugs thog phyogs bzhir sgro gshog sgar ba chu shugs kyis 'khor gyi yod/mchod rten la pad spungs mchod rten dang / byang chub mchod rten/bkra shis sgo mang mchod rten/ cho 'phrul (bdud 'dul )mchod rten/lha babs mchod rten/ dbyen 'dum mchod rten/ rnam rgyal mchod rten/myang 'das mchos rten bcas mchod rten cha brgyad du grags shing /mchodarten gyi thig rtsa sogs la phyag srol mi 'dra ba yod la/ bzo lta'i bkā spyang gsal mchod rten brgyad por bang rim la pad ma spungs pa

dang / zur bzhi pa/ bang rim ngos su sgo mang po/ zur bcu gnyis pa/bum sgo'i mdun ngos skas gsum sgrig bang rim gyi zur btubs pa/bang rim zlum po/ bang rim med pa'i bum pa dril gzugs bcas yod pa de rnams re res ston pa'i mdzad pa dang 'brel ba'i lo rgyus re yod pa tshang ma 'dir bris na ar las dang 'brel ba med stabs yig tshogs che bar sems/ mchod rten brgyad kyi bzo dbyibs dang mi 'dra ba'i mchod rten sa 'bum chen po mang po gang sar mthong rgyu yod la/ bon lugs kyi mchod rten mang po yod/ khang bu brtseg pa ni gru bzhi yin stabs mtshod rten gzhan dang mi 'dra ba yin/ mchod rten rtsig tshul thad rdo shing sogs kyi las rigs 'dzoms dgos pa ni ar las spyi mtshungs yin yang thig rtsa sogs khang pa dang mi 'dra bar chos phyogs kyi phyag bzhes ltar tshad bzung nas brtsig dgos/ 'on kyang mchod rten ni gser dngul zangs lcags sogs la lugs rdung byas pa dang / rdo la dkrug pa/ shing la rkos sgrig 'jim la bzos pa sogs che chung sna tshogs yod par brten mchod rten rtsig stangs de rtsig bzo rig pa'i dmigs bsal gyi rigs shig yin/ 27

bzhi pa/ chu 'khor sogs/chu 'khor/ chu 'khor gyi bzo stangs ni/ yur bu zhig khang pa'i phyogasagacig gi rtsig 'og brgyud chu gzar shugs che tsam yod pa'i 'or par brten nas khang 'og tu 'khor gdan steng bslangs pa'i shing dum sgro gshog can de'i sgro gshog chu shugs kyis 'khor ba byas nas shing dum de'i nang du yod pa'i lcags sam shing gi lte ba khang pa'i nang du bton pa der rang 'thag btsugs pa'i yas rdo 'khor gyi yod/ chu 'khor gyi 'or pa dang / sgro gshog sgar sa'i gdung ma/ lcam shing sogs lcang ma dang glang tsher sogs la byas na shing cha mi rul ba'i khyad yod/ khang pa'i nang gi rang 'thag dang 'or kha sogs bzo rtsal mi 'dra ba ma gtogs khang pa'i rtsig pa sogs khang pa spyi mtshungs yin/gzhan yang / bkar khang dang mkhar tshang sogs ni 'bru rigs bkar 'jug bya yul dang snum btsir sa sogs khang nang du bcug pa'i dngos po dang las ka bya yul gyi ming yin pa las rtsig bzo mi 'dra ba med/'ogata/ 'or khar kha rgyun du o chu dang / o pa sogs zer zhing khang pa phal che bar shing phyed gshags byas nas khog pa drus te yang steng gi ༵༵ la'i 'og nas phyir bton gyi yod/ phyis su lcags shog dang

zangs sogs las bzo srol yod/ khang pa la lar zangs kyi mdong mor sgrig pa'i yas sne khang steng du chu 'gro sa dang mas sne chu 'bab sar rdo'i 'or kha bzos nas chu phyir gtong gi yod/sgo'irigs/ khang pa'i nang gi sgo phal cher pang leb las bzos shing / sgo'i log ya gcig gi yas mas gnyis la sgo 'dzin byed cen kha zhes pa'i yas sne ri gzhi'i ya them gyi ngos gcig dang mas sne them gyi 'gram sne gcig la btsugs pa'i sgo pang gi ngos ya gcig der lcags sgor dang ngos de'i ri gzhir mdzo sna sgar ba'i nang der a shing gi sne mo rgyu sa/sgo pang gi nang du a shing sgar srol yod/ a shing re 'ga' sgo'i phyi ngos sasgor mo zhig bzos nas a shing phye rgyag byed sa sgo'i phyi nas byas chogadagon pa'i 'du khang sogs dang khang chen gyi phyi sgo phal cher nyis gshibs yin/ mkhar rdzong dang lcags ri'i rgyal sgo gdung ma bsgrigs nas bzo srol yod/ sgo chen phal che bar sgo 'bor zhes phub lcags a long dar mtshon drug bcings can re dang / sgo shan sogs lcags bkrol gser tshag can nam gtir tshag (tshag ris dkar po ) can/ sgo sdem (a shing )gnyis brtsegs/ mdzo sna (mkhar rdzong dang lcags rir mdzo sna lcags sgor nang du bzo srol yod )them pa'i ngos dang lcags sgor glegs sgo'i ya gcig gi gsham du sgar srol yod/ gling kha'i lcags ri dang phyugs ra sogs la lar rgyug ril gyi sgo yang bzo ba dang / mas them rdo la dkrug nas bzo ba sogs kyang yod/ 29

lnga pa/ ar ka dang ar gzhas/rang ljongs su de sngon ar 'dam sogs deng rabs kyi ar rgyag rgyu cha med pa dang / bar skabs 'ga' zhig gis phyi nas nang 'dren byas kyang 'grim 'grul sogs kyi dka' ngal che bas phon chen rang bed spyod bya thabs med stabs rang ljongs kyi sa khul phal che bar khang pa'i thog dang mthil zhal/ gong chu'i nya rgyab sogs tshang mar ar ka bed spyod byed cing / de ni yun ring gi srol rgyun ldan pa'i ar rgyag lag rtsal gyi gras shig red/ ar ka sngog 'don byas pa nas zhal ba bting ma zin bar brgyud rim mang tsam yod pa ste/1 ar ka thon sa ni/ rang ljongs kyi sa khul phal cher nas thon pa dang / de yang ri 'dabs dang ri ldebs sogs su sa ba dkar dang sa dmar yod sar yod cing / sa dang / ba dkar/ rdo hrug yar ka rnams pang gdan gyi khra ltar bam rim gyis chags yod/ ar ka la yang ar dkar dang ar dmar gnyis su yod par lha sa khul du ar ka dmar po de legs par brtsi zhing / ar dmar de rigs lha sa'i nye 'dabs byang ngos pha bong kha dang / lho ngos grib/ shar ngos yer pa sogs nas thon/ lhag par pha bong kha nas thon pa'i ar ka ni spus leXsdu su brtsis te lha sa'i ar gzhas su yang / pha bong kha nas thon

pa'i/ / ar ka dus gsum kun gsal/ / 'bog rdo rgyag ni ma dgos/ / gzimachung 'od kyis khengs so/ / zhes bstod bsngags byed srol yod/2 ar bcag byed stangs ni/ ar ka sngog 'don zin rjes rdzogs nas drug drug bzos te zhib rtsing khag gsum du dbye ba 'byed cing / de la hrob dang / bar hrob/ nas 'dra zhes 'bod/ tshags zin pa'i thal ba ni ar com zhes pa bye ma dang bsres nas rtsig ldebs zhal ba gtong chog pa dang / (lha sku bzhengs rgyu byas chog pa )mthil zhal lta bur mtshon na thog mar ar ka hrob ces pa de khod snyoms bting (ji tsam mthug na legs )nas 'bog rdo gzhu mkhan rnams gral bstar bsgrigs nas phar 'gro tshur 'gro byas nas brtan po ma chags bar 'bog rdo dal por gzhu dgos pa dang / de nas chu sim sim gtor nas sra brtan byung mtshams bar hrob ces pa de gtor nas gong ltar bcag de rjes nas 'dra zhes pa de bkram ste skam bcag gang 'tsham byas nas chu gtor/ smyug zho bslangs pa zhes 'dag zho bslangs/ (sla bcos byas na ar tsam bsres na mgyogs pa dang yag shos la ar rtsam bsre mi nyan )de rjes gral bstar bsgrigs te zha thag ma chod bar phar rgyug tshur rgyug gis 'bog rdo gzhu dgos/ 'bog rdor 'dam pa mi 'gos pa dang skam sgra thon skabs chu rdo 'jam pos dbur brgyab nas ar skyag ste 'dam ro bton dgos/('dam ro las na zhal bar ser ka gas nyen yod /snas

ras kyis phyis nas yom 'bog gi pags pa chu sbangs byas pa'i skyob ces pa de thengs gnyis gsum tsam byugs/ da dung legs shos la spos dkar sbang pa'i snum tsha po byugs na chu mi chags pa sogs kyi nus pa yod/ar ka thengs gcig bcag par dus tshod nyin lnga nas gsum gyi bar spyad na cung spus ka legs/2 bdag gnyer dang phan nus skor/ ar ka bcag zin pa'i zhal bar chu bsho rgyu med/ gang byung du chu bshos na zhal ba 'bar tshag chags nas gog nyen yod/ khang pa'i mthil zhal lta bur phyags ma 'jam pos 'phyags rjes yang lā dang dug do ba'i 'bras bu dmar po sogs phur nas dog phyis brgyab na zhal ba khra don pa dang 'od thon nas miganyam du mdzes la sra mkhregs su gyur/ thog steng lta bur char pa ma babs gong gad phyis gtsang ma byed pa dang char pa 'bab skabs mi 'gro mi nyan/ de ltar g.yog byed bdag gnyer yag po byung na lo mang ring chu srung thub pa sogs dge mtshan ldan pa dper na lho kha'i zangs ri rdzong 'ol dga' chus kyi dpal chen lha khang du 1950lo'i yas mas su ka ba gcig dum bur chag ste nyin bdun song yang thog ma rdib par gzhi nas ka ba gsar pa btsugs thub pa dang / stag rtse rdzong thang dkar chus khongs brag dbar (bar ba )dgon par yang gong mtshungs kyi gnas tshul byung ba/ de lnga'i gzhis rtse rdzong khang (de lha sa'i po ta la dang bzo dardidīs 'dra skad )gi 'og khang zhig gi ka ba chag kyang der sdod kun

gyis dus tshod ga tsam phyin min ma shes rung steng khang du skyon cha gang yang ma byung bar rjes su ka ba gsar pa btsugs thub pa sogs dngos yod gnas tshul mang po yod pa de tsho ni ar ka spus dag bcag pa'i rkyen gyis red la/ deng skabs kyang dgon pa dang khang rnying 'ga' zhig bar lam bdagagaces ha cang zhan rung thigs pa rgyag pa sogs nyung bas dgon rnying la lar lo mang song ba'i shing char rul skyon byung med stabs 'du khang sogs khang pa da lta mu mthud bod spyod thub pa sogs mdor na rang re'i bod kyi mes po rnams kyi blo gros snying bcud cig yin/rang ljongs su las ka gang byas kyang las gzhas re yod/ lhag par ar ka gcog skabs ni glu gar shin tu 'khrug po zhig yin/ las ga'i go rim bzhin 'bog rdo gsum rgyag dang 'bog gcig ces pa sogs zhu dgos la gzhas kyang dal gzhas dang/ rgyug gzhas/ lag 'khyer dang pad skor/ zhabs bro dang skor ba sogs spro snang ldan la rol rtsed kyi rnam pa lta bu yod pa de la dge mtshan ha cang ldan pa ni 'dam pa rnams rdo hrug gi gseb tu 'gro ba dang / gan thur 'gro phyogs/ rtsig 'gram du sbyar che ba/ las mi rnams las ka byed ring grung sha dod la snang ba skyid pa sogs yong gi yod/ ar gzhas la nang don dang gzhas gdangs sna tshogs yod pa de tsho'i nang 'dod gzhas dang / zur za/ bstod tshigadams ra/ sems gso/ ngar slong / rgyal rabs rnam thar gyi tshigadagod bro'i rigs/ ngal rtsol gyi bya rim/ chos tshig yul rdi spyan

khungs sogs yod pa de tsho tshang mar thun mong dang thun mong min pa'i gzhas gdangs sbyar chog de bzhin yul tsho so so'i dmangs gzhas kyang sbyar na 'grigs par brten las ka byed ring byed por spro snang dang / lta mkhan la bltas mo yang yod/ dper na gzhas tshig tu yang / shes pa rnams tshos gzhas la ram skyor gnang / / ma shes rnams tshos gzhas la gzigs mo gzigs/ / ces dang / rna ba gzhan la ma yengs glu la nyon/ / lag pa gzhan la ma yengs gsum rgyag gzhus/ / zhes sogs las ka dang glu gar kha 'bral du mi rung ba dang / nor bu ri dang /dkar mo gling zhes pa sogs kyi yul gyi thon khungs dang / 'od zer sgrol ma zhes pa ni bde mo sprul sku gong ma zhig gi bdag mo 'od zer sgrol ma zhes pa de kha 'bras mtshar la dang dod che ba la zer ba/ jo lags mi 'gyur zer ba de rgyal rtse dang lha sa'i bar du 'gro 'ong byed mkhan pho gzhon zhig la zer ba sogs yod/ gzhan yang / lug gu ma sdod spang gi ldebs la 'gro/ /lug gu'i a ma sems pa ma skyo zhig /gtan du spang ri'i ldebs la sdod dogs med/ / spang rtswa yag po bzas nas log pas chog / zhes pa sems gso'i tshig dang/ lcags ri dang po'i nang la slobs tsa na/ /'gros chen rta pho gcig dang mnyam du byung/ / chung dus a ma'i khog nas gshibs pa min/ / 'gros dang goms pa sbyong dus mnyam du byung / / zhes sogs las grogs dang dga' rogs byung tshul/ rab ga~X nang la/ mi pho'i dkyil la/ dpa' la che ba/ ge sar rgyal po/

zer ba sogs bstod bsngags byed pa/ ma 'gyur dgu 'gyur zhes pas rang 'byung khams kyi 'gyur ldog bkra shes bkra shis lags zhes pas chos tshig sogs mdor na gzhas tshig dang gzhas gdangs brjod kyis mi langs pa yod pa de dag la ar gzhas gtong len skabs/ ga'as de nyin gang btang na nyin gang yod/ / ga'as de mtshan gang btang na mtshan gang yod/ / gzhas la nyin mtshan sbrel nas ma btang na/ /gzhas dpon mkhas pa zhig gi ming don med/ / zer ba sogs gzhas shagasakhyed pa ma zad/ lhag par khyim tshang gnyis kyi yang steng du ar bcagatag gnyis dus gcig tu byung na gzhas shags mtshan mo phyi po'i bar thag ma chod pa yang yod/ de ltar snang ba skyid pa dang 'khrug cha che la spus ka dag po yong gi yod pa red/drug pa/ ar las kyi 'phel rim/lo rgyus kyi yig cha phal che ba zhig gi nang spyi lo'i sngon gyi lo brgya lhag tsam gyi gong du gnya' khri btsan po'i sku dus su pho brang yum bu bla sgang brtsigs pa de mkhar gyi thog ma yin zhes 'khod pa las rtsa ba'i ar las dar tshul ma gsal yang nye sngon chab mdo sa khul gyi kha ro gna' shul/ lha sa'i byang brgyud kyi chos grong sogs nas lo bzhi stong sngon gyi khang shul thon pa de tsho'i rtsig pa dang deng skabs zhing 'brog sa khul 'ga' /lha kyi

rags skyor kyi rtsig pa khyad par min 'dugamakhar gyi dang por grags pa'i yum bu bla sgang gi rtsig pa rgyag stangs ni rtsig rdo ha cang chen po med kyang rtsig sgrog dam la nang du rgya khyon de tsam med pa 'go nas rtse bar thog brtsegs med rung skas rim brgyud rtse mor 'gro sa dang / rtse mor so khung / steng nas shod bar rdzog rdo 'phang lam gyi gnam sgo yod pa bcas red/ (spen bad dang/ rgya phebs phyis su skrun )de 'dra'i rtsig pa (gyang gog )kong po dang / sna dkar rtse/ rin spungs sogs kyi sa khul mang por da lta'ang mthong rgyu yod pa de tsho bzo dbyibs ha lam 'dra po 'dug skabs 'dir gling rgyu zhig la rin spungs rdzong ba thang chus kyi khongs su sbam tsher gzhis kyi shar ngos lung shur zhig tu she mo sa zhes pa'i mkhar shul zhig yod pa de she sa dpon mo'i mkhar yin skad/ sbam tsher gzhis ma'i 'dzin bdag gi bka' gtan nang btsan po khri srong lde btsan gyi skabs de khul she sa dpon mo zhes pa zhig byung ba der btsan po'i gzigs skyong thob tshul dang / dpon mos kyang btsan por sri zhu byas lugs 'khod yod skad la dpags na btsan po'i dus su sde dpon nam lung tshan gyi bdag po re 'ga'i mkhar yang yum bu bla sgang gi dbyibs ltar bzo srol med dam snyam pa dpyad/ bod kyi ar las la rang nyid kyi sngar yod lag rgyun gong 'phel btang ba'i rmang gzhi'i thog mi rigs gzhan gyi lag rtsal yang blardoswā nas rang gi lag rtsal la kha gsab kyis phun sum tshogs su btang

nas 'phel rgyas btang ba zhig red/ spyi lo'i dus rabs bdun pa'i nang thang rgyal rabs kyi skabs btsan po srong btsan sgam pos pho brang po ta la dang / ra sa 'phrul snang / rgyas btab ra mo che sogs gsar skrun mdzad skabs lha khang gi bzo dbyibs ni bal po dang / rgya gar/ rgya nag bcas nas dpe blangs pa dang 'brel rgya bal gyi lag rtsal dang zung 'brel gyis bzo skrun mdzad pa red/ bal bza' khri btsun btsan po srong btsan sgam po'i btsun mor phebs rjes pho brang po ta la rgyas skrun mdzad skabs kyi bzo dbyibs skor rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long sogs su gsal bar lcags ri'i phreng ba gsum gyis bskor ba'i nang mkhar dgu brgya dgu bcu rtsa dgu dang / rtse mor rgyal po'i sku mkhar dang bcas stong yod pa sogs mkhar gyi bzo bkod gsungs pa de ltar lha sa'i gtsug lag khang gi nang dang rtse pho brang gi gsum skas sgo mchor 'og bris pa der mkhar dbus ma thog brtsegs can ha cang mtho ba zhig la khang pa dma' ba mang pos bskor yod pa lcags ri'i khyad par ma gtogs yum bu bla sgang dang 'dra ba 'dug kyang / rgya khyon dang sge khung sogs yum bu bla sgang dang bsdur na po ta la legs bcos che ba byung 'dug lha sa'i jo khang gi bzodabyibs ni rgya gar gyi bi kra ma la shī la'i lha khang la dpe byas nas bzhengs tshul gtsug phreng sogs kyi gsungs pa de bden par sems zhes deb dkar nang rgyu mtshan dang bcas ra sprod mdzad cing / de'i bzo khyad ni ka ba sbom la thung ba/ ka gzhu dang sgo'i ru bzhi sogs la )spyas

bkrol gyis brgyan pa/ lcam gyi sner seng ge'i gzugs brnyan sogs yod/thog yangs kyi dkar gsal gyis sgo brgyud khang pa'i nang gsal ba byas pa las sge khung med/ skabs der so phag kyang bed spyod byas tshul lo rgyus su bkod pa de ltar/ 1971lo lha sa'i gtsug lag khang gi rtsig pa nyams gso byed skabs rtsig gzhi rnying pa rnams so phag dmar po dang rdo g.yamachoyin 'dug pas mi lo chig stong sum brgya'i gong nas bod du so phag bzo shes thub/ de mtshungs 'un khreng kong jos kyang rgya nag nas bzo bo bkug ste rgya nag gi lha khang la dpe byas nas ra mo che'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs par mdzad pa rgya stag ra mo che zhes grags/ dus rabs brgyad pa'i nang btsan po khri srong lde btsan gyi sku dus su bsam yas gtsug lag khang gsar bzhengs mdzad skabs rgya gar dang / rgya nag bod gsum gyi khyad chos dang ldan pa'i mdzes bkod phun sum tshogs pa'i lugs gsum mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang zhes pa de'i phyi'i dbyibs rgya gar gyi o tan ta pū ri'i gtsug lag khang la dpe byas/ nang gi bkod pa ni rtsig zheng che ba dang / thog dpang mtho ba/ bar khang steng khang rnams dkar cha che ba sogs yod pa red/ 'on kyang bsam yas su me dgra'i bgegs bar thengs kha shas byung bas snga phyir zhig gso thengs 'ga' shas byas stabs bzo dbyibs la 'gyur ba phran bu byung yod nges kyang / rten gtso jo bo byang chub chen po'i bzhugs khang dang / de'i sterdo sbyong rnams sngon ma'i bzo dbyibs de rang yin 'dug pa ni jo bo

byang chub chen po'i bzhugs gnas sding cha dang rtsig zheng gis shes thub/skabs der rdzo phag kyang bod spyod byas shing / rdza phag g.yu rtsi can gyi mchod rten sngon po de bzhig pa'i so phag da lta bsam yas gyi gang sar mthong rgyu yod pa dang / 1945lo'i yas mas su bsam yas rdzong sdod thub bstan legs smon gyis sa stong gsar sbol khyon che byed skabs sa 'og nas so phag dmar po chen po dang khro lcags rdog rdog mang po thon pa mi ser gyis khro lcags de tshos gshol lcags kyi kha bzos pa sogs byas pa dang / 1961lo dge rgyas li ma lha khang bsheg skabs rtsig pa so phag dmar po khro chus sbyar ba ma zad/ rtsig rdor khro lcags bzhun ma bsres pa'i lo rgyus deb cither nang bkod pa ltar 'dug pa de thog nas skabs de'i ar rgyag la yun brtan yong rgyur do snang ha cang chen po byed kyi yod pa mtshon/ bu tshal gser khang phyi la rtsig pa med pa nang du ka ba med pa sogs bzo sna bcu gsum gyi khyad 'phags can gsungs pa de ni shing sangs glang sna gcig rtseg gnyis gnon byas te steng du shing sangs je ring dang glang sna je cher btang nas thog bkab 'dug pas de dus bod du ar las la gsar gtod kyi rang bzhin che tsam byung 'dug dus rabs bcu pa'i nang btsan po ral pa can gyis 'u shang rdo dpe med bkra shes dge 'phel gtsug lag khang zhes pa 'og thog gsum rdo dang/ bar thog gsum sa phag stong thog gsum shing las grub pa/ thog re re bzhin bya 'dab/ sgo/ pha gu dra phyed sogs kyis mdzes pa/ steng gi rgya phuX snang

zad/ lho lta ma yin pa'i sgo dang sge khung la yang nag rtsi gtong don ni tshang ma gzhi mtshungs kyi mdzes cha yin par shes/ nag pos nyi 'od 'then pa dang dkar pos nyi 'od bkag pa de rang re'i mes po tshos sngar nas shes kyi yod pa mtshon/ zhal ba mdzub ris/ khang pa sa phag gi rtsig pa yin na phyi ngos su zhal ba nges par gtong gi yod/ zhal ba'i ngos su mdzub ris gzhu dbyibs can brtsegs mar bris pa'i bar na mdzub ris nyis shur re thad kur gzhung du 'then yod/ char chu rtsig ldebs su phog skabs zhal ba'i mdzub ris brgyud chu rnams sa thog tu song stabs rtsig par srung skyob thub kyi yod/spen bad/ spen bad ni mdzes cha tsam ma zad/ khang steng du rlung bu'i shugs len pa'i khyad chos dang / phyog mdel len pa/ 'bar gas mi byed pa sogs kyi dge mtshan ldan yod/ka ba brje stangs/('gyogs rgyag stangs ) bod khang gi ka bar skyon cha byung yod na ka ba gsar brje byed stangs ni ka ba skyon can de'i gzhu chung la shing sbom phra ka ba las phra tsam gnyis btsugs pa'i 'og tu shing ring thung dang sbom phra snyoms pa re re'i rtse mo ka skyor de'i 'og tu bcug nas rtsa ba gyen du bkan pa'i steng nas bye ma do po'am mi grangs mang nyung cha snyoms kyis mnan/ shing bzo ba de'i bkod 'doms bzhin dal bus mnā/ te gdung ma btegs rjes ka ba rnying pa skyon can de tshur blangs/

dbyibs la gru bzhi dang zlum mo gnyis su bzo srol yod la/ lcam gyi rtsa ba rtsig steng du bzhag pa'i bar rdos mnan nas lcam rtsa gnyis mi thug pa dang mi 'gyur ba byed dgos par lcam rtsa rdo mnan zhes brjod srol de yin/gong gsal gdung ma nas lcam sngas bar gyi shing rnams 'og ma 'og ma las gong ma gong ma rim bzhin ring ba dang / lcam ni rtsig pa nas gdung ma'i bar dang gdung ma phan tshun bar stob pa'i shing ring po zhig yin dgos/dralam/ lcam gyi steng du gtong ba'i shing phra mo de la zer zhing /dral ma la steng sgrig dang / pang leb/ dral ma spyir btang sogs yod/dral ma steng sgrig ni dgon pa'i 'du khang ngam chos khang / gzim chung la gtong zhing / de yang shing gi yal ga pags pa bshus pa'am yang shing gshags pa ring thung khru gang (kung gling lnga bcu yas mas )tsam sgom phra kung gling nyi shu tsam rgyab ngos dang sne gnyis leb gzugs can bzos te lcam gnyis kyi bar du bsgrigs pa de yin/ de la dral ma sgrig skabs gseg bgrod can la chu ris can yang zer/ de min pang leb kyi dral ma dang shing gi yal ga shing gshags tshal sogs gang yin yang lcam gnyis kyi bar du phred la gtong dgos/ dral ma pang leb bam de min gang yin rung ha cang ring drags na stong du ar ka gcog skabs shing 'chus nas zhaX zlor ser kha gas kyi yod/

dralardo/ dral ma'i steng du chu rdo bkram pa de la zer/ dral rdo yag shos ni chu rdo yin la shing thog tu rdo yang zhes dral rdo de mang tsam yod na skyon med skad/thog 'dag dral rdo'i thog sa tshi can gyi 'dam pa bkram steng rdog brdzis btang ste bcag bcag gtong dgos/ar ka/ ar ka ni khang pa'i mthil dang / thog ka/ gong chu'i steng bcas la bcag srol yod/ de yang ar ka rdog rdog rnams hrug drug bzos rjes tshags ma zhib rtsing gsum du btsags rjes rdog po che ba der hrob dang/ 'bring ba der bar hrob/ chung ba der nas 'dra zer/ khang pa'i nang gi mthil zhal dang yang thog steng ar ka gcog skabs ar ka hrob ces pa de 'khod snyom po bting rjes 'bog rdos (rdo leb sgor mo dkyil du khung phug pa'i nang lag 'ju shing gi yal ga mi gzugs kyi ring thung tsam sgar ba )bcag bcag btang nas ar ka rnams 'gul skyod med pa chags mtshams bar hrob bting ste bcag de rjes nas 'dra bkram nas skam chag gang tsam byas rjes chu gtor te smyag zho ('dag zho )bslangs rjes chu thag ma chod bar 'bog dos bcag rjes chu rdos dbur brgyab ste 'dam pa rnams bton nas ar ka khra don pa bzos steng yom 'bog gi pags pa skam po chu la sbang pa'i tshi sna byugs par skyob btang ba zer/ de'i stong bza' snum tsha po bzos te byug dgos/ thog kha'i mar kur char zhod ma tshugs gong gad phyis gtsang ma byas rjes char swāhā po

'bab skabs thog kur byung na 'gro rgyu med/skas 'dzegs/ skas 'dzegs la rdo skas dang shing skas gnyis su yod/khang pa phal che bar thog sa dang po nas gnyis par 'gro sa rdo skas dang /yangan rdo skas thog sa phyed tsam gyi steng shing skas sgrig srol yod/ shing skas la sgrom skas dang skas rim gdung skas ('dre skas zhes khams khul du dar che )sogs yod/ dgon pa'i sgo mchor kyi mdun la sgo mchor gyi zheng dang mnyam pa'i rdo skas phyogs gsum nas 'dzegs sa yod pa de rdo skas pad srungs zer/ pho brang ngam rdzong khang gi sgo mchor mdun dang /lha khang gtso bo 'ga' zhig la rdo skas steng sgrom skas gsum sgrig 'dzugs srol yod/ 'og khang la rdo skas bzo ba las thog brtsegs gnyis yan la sgam skas sam sgrom skas ma gtogs rdo skas mi bzo ba ni 'og khang la gnon shugs mi yong ba'i ched du yin/ rgyug ril skas gdang byas pa'i sdus 'dzegs ni mi ser gyi khang pa phal che ba'i yang steng gi 'dzegs skas na/sgo'i ru bzhi/ de ni sgo chen sgo chung gang yin yang stong dang g.yas g.yon gyi ru ste shing gru bzhi la zer/ dgon pa'i 'du khang dang / pho brang gi tshoms/ gzim chung / lha khang sogs kyi sgo'i ru bzhi pad ma chos brtsegs dang sgo steng du sgo che chung la gzhigs te babs dang bre ring thung sogs bzo srol yod/53na bad/ spen bad ni khang pa'i yang steng du gtong gi yod/ de ni

shing spen ma'i sdong sdum gyi phyi lpags bshus nas rtsa ba snyom po bzos pa rgyun pos bsdams pa sbom phra lag ngar tsam byas pa rtse mo nang dang rtsa ba phyi la bstan te rtsig pa'i bar seng rnams rdo 'os 'tsham res bsnan pa'i rtse ngos su rdo rig brgyab steng du shing sangs dang / bad phur kha shing btang steng bad g.yam dang gong chu bzos/ spen bad rkyang brtsegs dang nyis brtsegs sogs spen ma shing rul skyon mi yong la rgyun bus bsdams pas dbyar shing bzha' rgyas skabs rgyun bu lhug tu 'gro ba dang / dgun dus rgyun bu skam nas dam por gyur/ spen bad kyis khang pa'i steng du rlung gi gnon shugs yang ba sogs kyi khyad yod/bad phur kha shing khang pa thog brtsegs mtho dma' ji ltar yin yang phyi rtsig yongs rdzogs rtsig zin rjes gong chu'i rtsig pa'i phyi ngos su shing gru bzhi re'i bar du skar ma nyi shu tsam gyi stong cha re bzhag pa'i bstar pa der bad phur zer ba dang / de'i stong du phred la btang ba'i shing gru bzhi der kha shing zer/bad g.yam ni/ kha shing steng bkab pa'i rdo g.yam der zer/ gtong stangs thad rdo g.yam bstar pa khrid pa'i gnyis re'i steng rdo g.yam re btang ba de yin/nya0ba/ bad g.yam gyi steng du khrid pa'i tshi can nya'i sgal pa lta bu'i zlum bu der zer/ nya rgyab la ar ka dang ar rdzus (ba dkar dang ba sag bsres pa )yang bcag srol yod/ 59

rtsub zhal/ zhal gdan la rtsub zhal yang zer/ rtsig pa'i nang ngos su gtong dgos pa yin/ de yang khang pa 'og khang gi rtsig ldebs su rtsub zhal kho nas 'thus pa dang / stong khang khag dang bar khyams la rtsub zhal steng zhal chen zhes 'jam zhal gtong gi yod/ rtsub zhal ni sa dkyus ma dang bye ma bsres pa'i 'dam pa rtsig ldebs su byugs steng shing gi 'ded bang (shing mdun ngos 'jam la rgyab tu lag 'ju yod pa zhig )gis 'khod snyom dgos/'jam zhal/ 'jam zhal la zhal chen yang zer/ sib pa bye ma (chu chen rgyug shul gyi bye ma 'jam po )gsum cha gnyis la sa ba dkar zhib mo gsum cha gcig bsres te 'dam pa g.yos pa de rtsub zhal gyi steng byug thog rdo 'jam pos dbur rgyag gi yod/ rtsig ngos su ldebs ris 'bri dgos/ zhal ba ha cang 'jam la 'khod snyom po dgos pa yin/mthil zhal/ khang pa'i phyi nang gi mthil du bting nas bcag pa'i ar ka dang ar rdzus (ba dkar dang ba sag bsres pa )kyi zhal bar zer ba yin la 'og khang la rdo ril bting pa'i mthil zhal yang yod/pang gcal/ pang gcal ni gzim chung lta bu'i nang ma gtogs mi sgrig kyang kong po sogs shing cha 'bel po yod sar khang mig phal cher bar pang gcal sgrig srol yod/ pang gcal yag shos ni star ka shing dang shug pa'i pang leb dkar dmar khra sgrig srol yod/65 gcal/ rdo gcal ni 'og khang dang ra sgor nang bting gi yod/

rdo bcal phal cher rdo g.yam yin la/ rdo ring dkar nag khra sgrig pa'i rdo gcal yang 'duganag rtsi/ nag rtsi ni khang pa'i sgo dang sge khung gi 'gram pa g.yas g.yon dang / ka phebs khor yug gi ka hrag bar gyi nyen skyor sogs la gtong gi yod/ sgo sge khung gi 'gram pa g.yas g.yon la rtsub zhal btang steng ba dkar dang sib pa bye ma bsres pa'i 'jam zhal btang nas dbur rdos phur bzhin du rdo nag (phal cher rdo sol min nam snyam )phye ma ras 'thums brgyab te deb bzhin du dbur rdo phur nas bzha' thag chod mtshams snum byug dgos/ nag rtsi sge khung gi mtha' la gtong ba'i dgos pa ni dgun dus khang pa'i nang nyi 'od 'then shugs che khyad yin/khang pa thog sa gsum yan dang spen bad khrid pa'i khang par bad phur kha shing nyis brtsegs gtong srol yod/ thog brtsegs bzhi yan gyi khang chen la spen bad nyis brtsegs bzo ba dang / dgon pa dang / pho brang / lha khang sogs rgyas spros che bar yang steng du gser zangs kyi rgya phibs dang / mda' g.yab/ gong chu'i phyogs mtshams su gser zangs kyi rgyal mtshan dang / gañdzi ra/ gzhan yang thug dang ras kyi rgyal mtshan/gong la'i zur du dril bu (zur dril zer )sogs 'dzugs srol yod/dgon pa dang lha khang la dar lcog 'dzugs srol med/ pho brang gi yang steng du dar lcog btsugs kyang dar lding gtong ba'i srol med/rdo bzo/ rdo bzo bas gtso bo rtsig pa'i 'gan 'khur byed la t+t+waṃ zlozo
